How do I create a stock order?: How do I create a stock order?
Go to Stocks, choose the Order Stock tab: Go to Stocks, choose the Order Stock tab, and select “Order Stock”. Choose a vendor, add products and quantities, then create your order. You can track the order right in the table.
What happens when I receive a delivery?: What happens when I receive a delivery?
